name: process-tabs
description: Save and switch between named sets of editor tabs without reorganizing your workspace or keeping a sidebar open.

Process Tabs: Add Current File to Active Process
Process Tabs: Add Current Tab Group to Active Process
Process Tabs: Use Current Editor Group as Process Area

processTabs.closePreviousOnSwitch.description: Close clean tabs from the previous process when switching. Only the process working editor group is managed; other editor groups and unsaved files are left untouched.

processTabs.showStatusBar.description: Show the active process in the VS Code status bar.

processTabs.autoAddOpenedFiles.description: Automatically add newly opened file tabs to the active process.

processTabs.removeClosedFiles.description: Automatically remove a file from the active process when its last open tab is closed manually. Tabs closed by Process Tabs while switching remain saved in the process.

processTabs.moveNewFilesToProcessArea.description: When a newly opened file is auto-added, place it in the Process Tabs editor area instead of leaving it in whichever editor group happened to be active.

processTabs.keepToolEditorsSeparate.description: Keep tool/custom-editor tabs such as Claude or ChatGPT in a separate editor group from process source files.
